lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid of approximately horizontal rows spanning the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of diffuse luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible above the pectoral fin, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a light upper highlight and a distinct shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, silver and dark-gray biotic features (remoras) trailing the pectoral fin and visible against the darker water column in the ventral foreground.
